card.name: Rechallenge and restarting after a reaction
card.fires_on: The word "challenge" after "re" (rechallenge), or words about restarting a drug, in warnings about recurring reactions. Also weaker on drug-name endings such as fumarate and lomitapide in liver warnings.

modes.label: Rechallenge
modes.description: The word challenge after re, describing recurrence of a reaction when a drug is given again.
modes.example: Recurrence of liver transaminase elevations occurred with re<<challenge>> in some patients.

modes.label: Restart wording
modes.description: Words about restarting a drug after stopping it because of a reaction.
modes.example: Do not<< restart>> labetalol in patients without another explanation

modes.description: Final part of a drug name in liver injury or interaction warnings.
